scene_type: 2D (motion in a plane facing the camera; front view of a Newton's cradle)
time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0
units: pixels (image x right, y DOWN) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (phase-correlation shift of the upper background vs frame 0 <= 0.035 px over all frames)
camera.perspective: near-frontal view; all five balls hang in one plane at the same depth (same pixel radius ~81.5 px); a single px scale applies to all balls. The base plate is seen slightly from above (trapezoid), not needed for ball motion.

glitch_frames.1: render glitch: frame 1 shows the stand with NO balls in place (only a stray half-ball near the base at x~560-720, y~860-960). Ball positions at frame 1 are unknown (visible=0 in tracks). If a question needs frame 1, interpolate between frames 0 and 2 (ball1 moves only ~0.6 px between frames 0 and 2; balls 2-5 are at rest).

ball1.desc: leftmost chrome ball; the one pulled out to the LEFT at the start and released; strikes the row

ball2.desc: second chrome ball from left (rest x~806)

ball4.desc: fourth chrome ball from left (rest x~1143)

ball5.desc: rightmost chrome ball; swings out to the RIGHT after the impact and swings back

ball_size_all.note: all five balls identical in size; fixed radii used in fits: 81.45, 81.50, 81.50, 81.75, 82.65 (ball5 slightly inflated by motion blur and ring overlap; best common value 163 +- 1 px diameter)

pendulum_arcs.note: arm length = pivot to ball centre (string + ball radius), from a circle fit to the ball-centre path. The strings are V-shaped pairs hanging from the two top rods (front rod y~206-217, back rod y~253-262).

frame_loop.desc: static dark stadium-shaped metal loop (stand) around the balls, passes IN FRONT of ball1 (frames 0-~19) and ball5 at rest/near rest

base_plate.desc: dark wooden rectangular base, seen slightly from above (trapezoid)

objects.background: light pink-grey wall with window-blind reflections, white floor with ball reflections; nothing else

rest_positions_px.note: balls 2-5 hang at y~791; ball1's lowest point is y~783 (8 px higher, its pivot is higher). Neighbour centre spacing ~168.4 px > diameter 163, i.e. a ~5 px visible surface gap between hanging balls.

events.event: ball1 released from rest (held out at left, upper-left of loop)
ball1 strikes the row (impact); ball1 stops at bottom, ball5 launched
events.note: ball1 moving ~22 px/frame up to frame 26->27 (21.5), 16.5 px in 27->28 then ~0.9 px/frame; ball5 moves 4.3 px in 27->28 and 22.5 px/frame from 28->29

events.event: balls 2-4 begin a small drift (ball2, ball1 leftward; ball4 rightward)
ball5 reaches maximum excursion (turning point, highest point)
ball1 / ball2 / ball3 / ball4 reverse their slow drift
ball5 swinging back left, still moving ~21.9 px/frame at last frame; next impact would be just after the video ends (~frame 81)
